name: qlrisk_price_german_bund
title: Price a GermanBund
description:
Price one German Bund (qlrisk GermanBund).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, face_value=100, coupon_pct*, frequency=annual, currency=EUR. In `advanced` also: effective_date, issuer, position.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "face_value": 100, "coupon_pct": 5} gives NPV 102.91 EUR (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
